ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a predominance of low-intensity dark pixels (~75%) against localized high-intensity white regions (~25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Significant high-intensity contiguous patch located on the medial portion of the left lobe; smaller high-intensity region at the distal tip of the right lobe; remaining fluke surface is mapped to low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged profile with high-frequency pixel variations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary, with maximum amplitude observed on the distal right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curve from the notch that transitions into highly irregular, non-linear trajectories at the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial distribution of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across both lobes, particularly concentrated on the medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss and jagged serration at the distal tip of the right lobe, distinct from natural pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The entire fluke surface is heavily overlaid with high-intensity circular noise consistent with water spray and droplets, partially occluding underlying skin textures.
